requirement: Supervise background subprocesses, managing lifecycle through termination, signal escalation, exit status reaping, and context manager cleanup.
skeleton: ManagedProcess class with start, is_running, wait, terminate, stop methods and context manager.

rationale.teaches: Supervising a child process: poll for liveness, wait with a kill escalation on timeout, terminate only a running process, validate the command vector, and reap on context exit.
rationale.why: A process that is never waited for stays a zombie and returncode stays None, but nothing raises. The fixture checks returncode and whether the pid still exists after stop.

candidates.why_wrong: wait returns 0 without waiting, so the child keeps running and is never reaped.
is_running reads returncode without polling, so a child that already exited is still reported as running.
terminate only acts when the process is not running, so a live process is never signalled.
A timeout of exactly 0 is accepted and every wait expires immediately.
A bare string command is accepted, so Popen receives it as a single program name with no arguments.
